title: The Midnight Drive
venue: Bayline Golf Social • Fictional Baton Rouge, Louisiana
description: A hard deduction mystery at a fictional Baton Rouge golf social club. A late-night influencer event ends with a death on the upper-deck service ramp, where a staged timeline, altered camera export, and competing alibis all point in different directions.

answerKey.method: Used a service-ramp gate delay and staged ball impact audio to lure Jalen onto the upper deck, then released a locked equipment cart so the fall looked like a reckless stunt.
answerKey.motive: To prevent Jalen from releasing proof that Sable was running a hidden betting syndicate through private bay challenges.
answerKey.keyEvidence: Gate delay log, cart brake fiber, altered camera export, audio loop metadata, and witness timing from the lower bays.
answerKey.explanation: Sable controlled the event media booth, which let her alter camera exports and trigger the impact audio loop. The physical cart evidence and gate delay prove the death happened later than her alibi claimed.

publicClues.title: Case Opened
publicClues.text: Jalen Rook is found below the upper-deck service ramp after a midnight influencer challenge at Bayline Golf Social. The range lights glow through mist, the ramp smells of hot metal and spilled citrus soda, and a cart brake line leaves a fresh black streak across the concrete.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: A producer says the “trick shot impact” sound played over the speakers before anyone saw Jalen fall. Sable Knox says the audio was part of the stream package, but her voice catches when the timestamp is read aloud.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: The lower bays keep playing because most guests think the fall was staged. A witness insists Jalen was still alive after the first impact sound, arguing on the service ramp with someone wearing a silver headset.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: A camera export arrives with a clean gap where the ramp should be visible. The missing section is too smooth, as if someone exported around the problem instead of losing signal.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: The equipment cart is rolled back into place. One wheel clicks every rotation, and a black fiber is caught in the brake housing.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: The final stream chat backup loads. Jalen had scheduled a post titled “Bayline bets are rigged,” but it was never published.

phone.title: Silver Headset Ping
phone.text: A Bluetooth headset registered at the upper ramp gate at 11:58 PM. Sable claims her headset stayed in the media booth, but the booth receiver lost it for ninety seconds.

phone.title: Jalen’s Scheduled Post
phone.text: Jalen scheduled a post called “Bayline bets are rigged” for midnight. It was canceled from a device logged into the event media Wi-Fi.

messages.title: Threat Draft
messages.text: A deleted draft on Jalen’s phone reads, “If I vanish, check Sable’s private challenge ledger.” The draft was never sent.

messages.title: Media Booth DM
messages.text: Sable received a message: “He has the ledger. End the stream early.” She answered with only a golf-ball emoji and a clock.

maps.title: Ramp Gate Delay
maps.text: The service-ramp gate shows a nine-second delayed close command at 11:58 PM. That delay is long enough for the equipment cart to roll free after someone steps away.

maps.title: Booth-to-Ramp Route
maps.text: The media booth connects to the upper ramp by a staff stairwell that does not cross the public bay floor. A person could leave and return without appearing in guest videos.

bank.title: Private Challenge Ledger
bank.text: The ledger shows private bay challenges tied to cash transfers, losing players, and odds shifts. Sable’s initials appear as the settlement approver.

bank.title: Influencer Payout Reversal
bank.text: A payout to Jalen was reversed thirty minutes before he died. The reversal note says “breach risk.”

photos.title: Ramp Brake Streak
photos.text: The ramp photo shows a fresh black brake streak starting behind the gate, not at the point where Jalen landed. That suggests the cart moved first and the fall followed.

photos.title: Camera Export Gap
photos.text: The exported camera file skips from 11:57:41 to 11:59:03 with no compression tear. A clean gap like that usually means an edited export, not a dropped feed.

social.title: Live Chat Backup
social.text: The live chat backup shows viewers hearing an impact sound before the camera angle changes. Several comments ask whether the sound effect was part of the show.

social.title: Unposted Exposé Clip
social.text: Jalen’s draft clip names a hidden challenge ledger and shows a blurred screenshot of Sable’s settlement initials.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Mina Bell, lower-bay guest
contacts.text: Mina says she heard the impact sound first, then saw Jalen still upright on the ramp arguing with someone in a silver headset.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Sable Knox, event producer
contacts.text: Sable says she stayed in the media booth cutting camera angles and never went near the ramp. She says the audio effect was triggered automatically by the stream package.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Orrin Chase, equipment runner
contacts.text: Orrin says the ramp cart brake was locked at the start of the event. When he found it after midnight, the brake housing clicked like something had been forced through it.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Trey Voss, trick-shot rival
contacts.text: Trey admits he argued with Jalen about fake odds, but says he was in the lower bay when the first impact sound played. Multiple guests place him there.

notes.title: Audio Loop Metadata
notes.text: The impact sound file was not triggered by a sensor. It was manually queued from the media booth console and looped for three seconds.

notes.title: Cart Brake Fiber
notes.text: A black fiber caught in the cart brake matches the fabric sleeve on the media booth headset case, not the cart cover.

files.title: Edited Export Manifest
files.text: The camera export was made from a selected time range, not the full stream archive. The missing ramp window was omitted before investigators received the file.

files.title: Challenge Ledger Backup
files.text: A backup ledger lists private bay challenges, odds changes, and settlement approvals under Sable’s initials. Jalen had downloaded it before the event.

browser.title: Search: Delay Gate Close Command
browser.text: The media booth browser searched how to delay a service gate close command through the venue control panel.

browser.title: Search: Clean Camera Export Gap
browser.text: The same browser searched how to export around a dead zone without leaving a visible compression jump.

openingNarration: Jalen Rook came to Bayline Golf Social to expose a hidden betting syndicate. By midnight he was dead under the upper-deck ramp, and the event media feed was already cleaned before investigators arrived.
revealScript: Sable Knox used the media booth to create a false timeline, played a staged impact sound, and released an equipment cart at the ramp gate. Jalen died because he had proof of the betting syndicate she built through private challenges.
